title: 媒体阅读与信息辨析 · 100 句
description: 新闻来源、统计报道、采访、社交平台、图片语境、订阅、公共讨论与信息责任。

items.zh: 报道没有给出事件日期。
items.en: The report omits the date of the event.
answers: The report omits the date of the event.

items.zh: 标题比正文说得更绝对。
items.en: The headline is more absolute than the article.
answers: The headline is more absolute than the article.

items.zh: 消息来源没有署名。
items.en: The source is unnamed.
answers: The source is unnamed.

items.zh: 这段内容属于评论。
items.en: This passage is commentary.
answers: This passage is commentary.

items.zh: 图片说明与照片不符。
items.en: The caption does not match the photograph.
answers: The caption does not match the photograph.
The caption doesn't match the photograph.

items.zh: 我们需要区分新闻和广告。
items.en: We need to distinguish news from advertising.
answers: We need to distinguish news from advertising.

items.zh: 这个事件仍在发展。
items.en: The situation is still unfolding.
answers: The situation is still unfolding.

items.zh: 文章后来补充了说明。
items.en: The article was later updated with clarification.
answers: The article was later updated with clarification.

items.zh: 我想找到最初的报道。
items.en: I want to locate the original report.
answers: I want to locate the original report.

items.zh: 转述可能遗漏上下文。
items.en: Retelling can leave out context.
answers: Retelling can leave out context.

items.zh: 链接指向另一个转载网站。
items.en: The link leads to another reposting site.
answers: The link leads to another reposting site.

items.zh: 这份声明来自当事人。
items.en: This statement comes from someone directly involved.
answers: This statement comes from someone directly involved.

items.zh: 匿名并不自动意味着虚假。
items.en: Anonymity does not automatically imply falsehood.
answers: Anonymity does not automatically imply falsehood.
Anonymity doesn't automatically imply falsehood.

items.zh: 我想知道证据从哪里来。
items.en: I want to know where the evidence originated.
answers: I want to know where the evidence originated.

items.zh: 截图看不出完整对话。
items.en: The screenshot does not show the entire exchange.
answers: The screenshot does not show the entire exchange.
The screenshot doesn't show the entire exchange.

items.zh: 日期显示它是旧消息。
items.en: The date shows that the story is old.
answers: The date shows that the story is old.

items.zh: 我们应该查看原始文件。
items.en: We should consult the original document.
answers: We should consult the original document.

items.zh: 两篇文章可能引用了同一来源。
items.en: Both articles may rely on the same source.
answers: Both articles may rely on the same source.

items.zh: 没有找到证据不等于证明不存在。
items.en: Failure to find evidence does not prove absence.
answers: Failure to find evidence does not prove absence.
Failure to find evidence doesn't prove absence.

items.zh: 核实需要比转发更长的时间。
items.en: Verification takes longer than forwarding.
answers: Verification takes longer than forwarding.

items.zh: 百分比没有给出样本量。
items.en: The percentage comes without a sample size.
answers: The percentage comes without a sample size.

items.zh: 平均收入可能掩盖差距。
items.en: Average income may conceal disparities.
answers: Average income may conceal disparities.

items.zh: 增长率与实际增量不同。
items.en: The growth rate differs from the absolute increase.
answers: The growth rate differs from the absolute increase.

items.zh: 图表纵轴没有从零开始。
items.en: The vertical axis does not start at zero.
answers: The vertical axis does not start at zero.
The vertical axis doesn't start at zero.

items.zh: 这项排名使用了不同口径。
items.en: This ranking uses a different basis.
answers: This ranking uses a different basis.

items.zh: 问卷只访问了订阅者。
items.en: The survey questioned subscribers only.
answers: The survey questioned subscribers only.

items.zh: 这个预测不是已经发生的结果。
items.en: This projection is not an observed outcome.
answers: This projection is not an observed outcome.
This projection isn't an observed outcome.

items.zh: 比较时应考虑人口规模。
items.en: Population size matters in the comparison.
answers: Population size matters in the comparison.

items.zh: 基于小样本的估计值可能波动很大。
items.en: Estimates based on small samples can fluctuate substantially.
answers: Estimates based on small samples can fluctuate substantially.
items.notes: based on 修饰 estimates；波动的是估计结果。

items.zh: 图表没有说明缺失数据。
items.en: The chart does not explain the missing data.
answers: The chart does not explain the missing data.
The chart doesn't explain the missing data.

items.zh: 先问开放式问题。
items.en: Begin with an open-ended question.
answers: Begin with an open-ended question.

items.zh: 这个问法可能暗示答案。
items.en: This wording may suggest an answer.
answers: This wording may suggest an answer.

items.zh: 我想确认能否引用原话。
items.en: I want permission to quote the exact words.
answers: I want permission to quote the exact words.

items.zh: 受访者可以拒绝回答。
items.en: The interviewee can decline to answer.
answers: The interviewee can decline to answer.

items.zh: 录音开始前要说明用途。
items.en: Explain the recording's purpose before starting.
answers: Explain the recording's purpose before starting.

items.zh: 我们需要给对方回应机会。
items.en: We need to allow an opportunity to respond.
answers: We need to allow an opportunity to respond.

items.zh: 停顿不一定表示同意。
items.en: A pause does not necessarily signal agreement.
answers: A pause does not necessarily signal agreement.
A pause doesn't necessarily signal agreement.

items.zh: 我会把摘要发给你核对。
items.en: I will send the summary for checking.
answers: I will send the summary for checking.

items.zh: 这句话是背景说明，不宜脱离语境。
items.en: This background statement needs its context.
answers: This background statement needs its context.

items.zh: 追问应围绕尚不清楚的部分。
items.en: Follow-up questions should address what remains unclear.
answers: Follow-up questions should address what remains unclear.

items.zh: 热门不等于有代表性。
items.en: Popularity does not establish representativeness.
answers: Popularity does not establish representativeness.
Popularity doesn't establish representativeness.

items.zh: 我看到的是平台筛选后的内容。
items.en: I see content selected by the platform.
answers: I see content selected by the platform.

items.zh: 这条帖子故意激起愤怒。
items.en: This post deliberately provokes anger.
answers: This post deliberately provokes anger.

items.zh: 评论区未必反映多数意见。
items.en: Comments may not reflect majority opinion.
answers: Comments may not reflect majority opinion.

items.zh: 重复出现会让说法显得熟悉。
items.en: Repetition can make a claim feel familiar.
answers: Repetition can make a claim feel familiar.

items.zh: 我不想在读完整篇文章之前转发。
items.en: I do not want to share the article before reading it in full.
answers: I do not want to share the article before reading it in full.
I don't want to share the article before reading it in full.
items.notes: in full：完整地；区分未读与尚未读完。

items.zh: 这段视频可能经过剪辑。
items.en: This clip may have been edited.
answers: This clip may have been edited.

items.zh: 转发者不一定核实过内容。
items.en: People sharing it may not have checked it.
answers: People sharing it may not have checked it.

items.zh: 我们可以先暂停通知。
items.en: We can pause notifications for now.
answers: We can pause notifications for now.

items.zh: 算法推荐不是个人背书。
items.en: An algorithmic recommendation is not a personal endorsement.
answers: An algorithmic recommendation is not a personal endorsement.
An algorithmic recommendation isn't a personal endorsement.

items.zh: 画面被裁掉了关键部分。
items.en: A crucial part of the image was cropped out.
answers: A crucial part of the image was cropped out.

items.zh: 这个角度隐藏了距离。
items.en: This angle conceals the distance.
answers: This angle conceals the distance.

items.zh: 声音可能是后期添加的。
items.en: The audio may have been added afterwards.
answers: The audio may have been added afterwards.

items.zh: 相机时间可能设置错误。
items.en: The camera clock may be wrong.
answers: The camera clock may be wrong.

items.zh: 高分辨率不保证真实性。
items.en: High resolution does not guarantee authenticity.
answers: High resolution does not guarantee authenticity.
High resolution doesn't guarantee authenticity.

items.zh: 视频缺少开始前的过程。
items.en: The video omits what happened beforehand.
answers: The video omits what happened beforehand.

items.zh: 演示画面需要明确标注。
items.en: Demonstration footage needs clear labelling.
answers: Demonstration footage needs clear labelling.

items.zh: 我们不应猜测照片中人的身份。
items.en: We should not guess the identities of people pictured.
answers: We should not guess the identities of people pictured.
We shouldn't guess the identities of people pictured.

items.zh: 画面中的地标有助于确认照片拍摄的位置。
items.en: Landmarks in the image can help establish where the photograph was taken.
answers: Landmarks in the image can help establish where the photograph was taken.
items.notes: establish where：确定位置；用可识别地标核实图像背景。

items.zh: 相似的场景不代表同一地点。
items.en: Similar scenes do not establish a shared location.
answers: Similar scenes do not establish a shared location.
Similar scenes don't establish a shared location.

items.zh: 这份通讯多久发送一次？
items.en: How often is this newsletter sent?
answers: How often is this newsletter sent?

items.zh: 我只想接收每周摘要。
items.en: I only want the weekly digest.
answers: I only want the weekly digest.

items.zh: 免费试读什么时候结束？
items.en: When does the free trial end?
answers: When does the free trial end?

items.zh: 订阅价格会自动调整吗？
items.en: Will the subscription price change automatically?
answers: Will the subscription price change automatically?

items.zh: 我希望关闭个性化推荐。
items.en: I would like to disable personalised recommendations.
answers: I would like to disable personalised recommendations.

items.zh: 这个来源有公开更正记录。
items.en: This source publishes its corrections.
answers: This source publishes its corrections.

items.zh: 我会比较不同立场的报道。
items.en: I compare coverage from different perspectives.
answers: I compare coverage from different perspectives.

items.zh: 信息太多时，我先确定需求。
items.en: When information overwhelms me, I clarify my need first.
answers: When information overwhelms me, I clarify my need first.

items.zh: 不是每条更新都需要立即关注。
items.en: Not every update needs immediate attention.
answers: Not every update needs immediate attention.

items.zh: 我想保留可供以后核查的链接。
items.en: I want a link I can revisit for verification.
answers: I want a link I can revisit for verification.

items.zh: 请把推测写成推测。
items.en: Present speculation as speculation.
answers: Present speculation as speculation.

items.zh: 这个措辞混淆了可能与必然。
items.en: This wording confuses possibility with certainty.
answers: This wording confuses possibility with certainty.

items.zh: 我需要说明不知道的部分。
items.en: I need to state what is unknown.
answers: I need to state what is unknown.

items.zh: 简短表达不应牺牲关键条件。
items.en: Brevity should not remove essential qualifications.
answers: Brevity should not remove essential qualifications.
Brevity shouldn't remove essential qualifications.

items.zh: 引用应保留原意。
items.en: A quotation should preserve the original meaning.
answers: A quotation should preserve the original meaning.

items.zh: 图例需要解释符号。
items.en: The legend needs to explain the symbols.
answers: The legend needs to explain the symbols.

items.zh: 我们可以用具体实例帮助理解。
items.en: A concrete example can aid understanding.
answers: A concrete example can aid understanding.

items.zh: 报道中的哪些证据支持标题所用的肯定语气？
items.en: What evidence in the report supports the headline's claim of certainty?
answers: What evidence in the report supports the headline's claim of certainty?
items.notes: claim of certainty：声称确定；询问证据与措辞是否匹配。

items.zh: 澄清应该出现在显眼的位置。
items.en: The clarification should be prominently displayed.
answers: The clarification should be prominently displayed.

items.zh: 我希望读者能分清已知和未知。
items.en: I want readers to separate known facts from uncertainty.
answers: I want readers to separate known facts from uncertainty.

items.zh: 反对一个观点不等于攻击一个人。
items.en: Challenging an idea is not attacking a person.
answers: Challenging an idea is not attacking a person.
Challenging an idea isn't attacking a person.

items.zh: 我们先确认争议点。
items.en: Let's identify the point of disagreement.
answers: Let's identify the point of disagreement.

items.zh: 对方的最强论据是什么？
items.en: What is the strongest opposing argument?
answers: What is the strongest opposing argument?

items.zh: 我愿意根据新证据改变看法。
items.en: I am willing to revise my view with new evidence.
answers: I am willing to revise my view with new evidence.

items.zh: 这个例子无法代表所有情况。
items.en: This example cannot represent every situation.
answers: This example cannot represent every situation.
This example can't represent every situation.

items.zh: 情绪反应和事实判断需要区分。
items.en: Emotional reactions differ from factual judgements.
answers: Emotional reactions differ from factual judgements.

items.zh: 我们不必在每个细节上达成一致。
items.en: Agreement on every detail is unnecessary.
answers: Agreement on every detail is unnecessary.

items.zh: 承认例外不会自动推翻整体论点。
items.en: Acknowledging exceptions need not invalidate the whole argument.
answers: Acknowledging exceptions need not invalidate the whole argument.
Acknowledging exceptions needn't invalidate the whole argument.

items.zh: 沉默的人也可能有不同意见。
items.en: Silent participants may disagree too.
answers: Silent participants may disagree too.

items.zh: 讨论应该给修正错误留下空间。
items.en: Discussion should allow room for correction.
answers: Discussion should allow room for correction.

items.zh: 公开个人信息需要谨慎判断。
items.en: Publishing personal information requires careful judgement.
answers: Publishing personal information requires careful judgement.

items.zh: 公共利益与公众的好奇心不同。
items.en: Public interest differs from public curiosity.
answers: Public interest differs from public curiosity.
items.notes: public interest 在此是公共利益，不是公众兴趣。

items.zh: 错误指认可能伤害无辜的人。
items.en: Mistaken identification can harm innocent people.
answers: Mistaken identification can harm innocent people.

items.zh: 更正需要覆盖原来的受众。
items.en: A correction needs to reach the original audience.
answers: A correction needs to reach the original audience.

items.zh: 我会明确注明利益关系。
items.en: I will disclose relevant interests.
answers: I will disclose relevant interests.

items.zh: 赞助关系应让读者看得见。
items.en: Sponsorship should be visible to readers.
answers: Sponsorship should be visible to readers.

items.zh: 没有证实的指控不能当成事实。
items.en: Unverified allegations cannot be treated as facts.
answers: Unverified allegations cannot be treated as facts.
Unverified allegations can't be treated as facts.

items.zh: 传播信息也是一种责任。
items.en: Distributing information carries responsibility.
answers: Distributing information carries responsibility.

items.zh: 删除帖子不一定消除影响。
items.en: Deleting a post may not erase its impact.
answers: Deleting a post may not erase its impact.

items.zh: 可靠性需要长期一致的做法。
items.en: Reliability requires consistent practice over time.
answers: Reliability requires consistent practice over time.
